europe_now.title: France investigates massive cyberattack on tax database
europe_now.summary: French authorities are probing a large-scale cyberattack targeting the national tax database, raising concerns about data security and state infrastructure resilience. The attack's scope and origin remain under investigation.

sources.headline: France probes tax database massive cyberattack

top_stories.title: Severe drought hits Europe with record-low harvests
top_stories.summary: A historic drought is devastating central and southern Europe, causing record-low harvests and prompting unprecedented water restrictions. The economic impact is stalling growth across the affected regions.

sources.headline: The great drought devours the heart of Europe: Record-low harvests, historic restrictions and a stalled economy

top_stories.title: Humanitarian crisis deepens in Ceuta as health system collapses
top_stories.summary: Thousands of young Moroccan migrants in Ceuta are refusing to leave despite dire conditions, while the enclave's health system faces a surge in gastroenteritis, tuberculosis, and scabies. Nurses report the system is at breaking point amid the ongoing migrant influx.

sources.headline: ‘We won’t go back’: Young Moroccan migrants in Ceuta refuse to abandon their European dream
Gastroenteritis, tuberculosis, scabies: Nurses say Ceuta’s health system is at breaking point

top_stories.title: EU defends International Criminal Court against US sanctions
top_stories.summary: European leaders have rallied behind the International Criminal Court after the United States imposed sanctions on its officials. The ICC president stated the court is absorbing blows aimed at international law itself.

sources.headline: EU backs top international court against onslaught from Trump and Rubio
The ICC stands firm against US pressure: ‘We are taking blows aimed at international law’

top_stories.title: Ukraine deploys Slovak MiG-29s to strike Russian bridges
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian forces have used Slovak-supplied MiG-29 fighter jets to destroy Russian bridges in a significant escalation of air operations. The deployment marks the first confirmed use of these aircraft for offensive strikes inside Russian-held territory.

sources.headline: Ukraine using Slovak MiG-29s to destroy Russian bridges (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,637)
